Maria (CS): Hey team — Orion Health go-live next Tue 09:00 UTC. Need final call on dedicated bring-up: quota numbers, autoscale policy, load-test window, and billing ramp. Who's available for a quick sync?
Kevin (SRE): I'm on. Can we confirm reserved pool: how many GPUs and which region?
Maria (CS): They committed to 8x A100-equivalent GPUs in eu-west-1. Ben, is that reflected in the order?
Ben (Platform): Yes — reserved pool 8 GPUs, slot id RP-ORION-2024. I also carved a soft headroom of +2 GPUs for burst. Billing ramp: propose 40% month1, 70% month2, 100% month3 (per contract).
Ashley (Solutions Eng): For load tests I can run a progressive soak Wed/Thu. Plan: 3 phases — 10m smoke, 2h ramp to target QPS, 6h sustained peak. Script ready: `./loadgen --target-qps 12k --seq-len 256 --workers 48 --duration 21600`
Kevin (SRE): Notes on autoscaling: we should prefer throughput-based scaling (req/s per GPU) with a circuit-breaker on P90 latency. Suggest policy: scale up when avg GPU_util > 70% for 90s; scale down after 10m stable < 40%. Also keep a minimum of 4 GPUs hot for latency SLO.
Maria (CS): Can you paste a sample policy snippet we can give ops/eng? I'll include in the runbook we share with the customer.
Kevin (SRE): Sure — snippet below:
```
autoscale_policy:
  metric: gpu_utilization
  scale_up:
    threshold: 0.70
    duration: 90
    step: +1
  scale_down:
    threshold: 0.40
    duration: 600
    step: -1
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 12
  latency_guard:
    metric: p90_latency_ms
    threshold: 300
    action: hold_scale_down
```
Ashley (Solutions Eng): Also we need KV cache priming before sustained run. Recommend running `prime_prefixes.sh` with the customer's top 5k prefixes (we have the dataset). Otherwise first 30 minutes will see high latencies.
Ben (Platform): Agreed. I'll provision a cache-warmup job to run 30m before the peak window. I'll tag it `orion-warmup-v1`.
Maria (CS): What about fallback plan if we hit quota or GPUs exhausted? We discussed routing to a smaller model variant for non-critical traffic.
Kevin (SRE): Yes — smart routing in place. Policy: when pool utilization > 95% or queue depth > 500, route `low_priority` traffic to `model-x-small`. Critical traffic stays pinned. We'll also enable prefailure alerts to PagerDuty.
Maria (CS): Sounds good. Who's owner for the fleet-level smoke test?
Ashley (Solutions Eng): I'll own loadgen and validation. Kevin — can SRE validate autoscale observability and alerts?
Kevin (SRE): Yep. I'll set up dashboards: GPU pool Util, queue depth, P50/P90 latency, error rate, and billing burn. Will add burn rate alert at 150% expected ramp.
DeployBot: Deploy pipeline `orion/dedicated/pool` started by Ben — build 0.8.3 -> canary -> staging -> prod (ETA 45m).
Ben (Platform): Canary will land on 1716790000 UTC. I'll post back when canary passes.
Maria (CS): Customer enablement: I'll run a 1hr kickoff with Orion success team Mon 15:00 UTC to walk through cutover steps and how to interpret dashboards. Please join if available.
Ashley (Solutions Eng): I'll join for the runbook walk-through. Kevin — can you join for failure-mode Q&A?
Kevin (SRE): Yes. Also quick ask: let's capture 10 representative prompts from Orion for post-rollout evals. We want automatic quality checks after the first 24h.
Maria (CS): I'll pull the prompts and share in the onboarding doc.
Ben (Platform): Action items I have: provision warmup job, verify reserved vs soft-headroom accounting, run canary, and confirm billing ramp flags.
Ashley (Solutions Eng): Action items: run load tests, validate priming script, provide acceptance criteria (latency < 350ms p90, error < 0.5%).
Kevin (SRE): Action items: configure autoscale policy in control plane, create dashboards + alerts, test fallback routing to model-x-small.
Maria (CS): I'll consolidate the runbook and share a single link here by EOD. Thank you. :thumbsup:
Ben (Platform): Canary passed — pushing to staging now. Patch notes: GPU driver updated, cache-warmup scheduled.
DeployBot: Canary -> staging promotion succeeded.
Ashley (Solutions Eng): Quick reminder: keep the first 30m of traffic tagged `smoke` so we can replay if needed.
Maria (CS): Great — closing this thread for now. We'll reopen if any issues during canary or load tests. 
Maria (CS): ACTIONS_SUMMARY: Maria->runbook link (EOD); Ashley->load tests + acceptance; Kevin->autoscale + dashboards; Ben->warmup + canary.
